name: Dwarves

variantInfo.name: Dwarf
notes: 16 Hitpoints, max hit 2 (stab), 5-tick attack speed, Defence level 6 (magic defence +5, all other bonuses 0).

variantInfo.name: Black Guard
notes: Level 25 form: 30 Hitpoints, max hit 3, Defence level 20 with small melee bonuses (npc 1409-1412).
A level 48 Keldagrim form (40 HP, max hit 8, Defence 45, npc 6046-6049) also counts toward the task.

locationComparison.name: Dwarven Mine
notes: The free-to-play Dwarven Mine holds the densest dwarf cluster (36 spawns).
The Dwarven Mine is single-way combat and safespottable, but a dwarf multicannon cannot be set up here (prohibited area).
Ice Mountain and Keldagrim Black Guards also count toward the task.

taskNotes: Dwarves requires combat level 6 to be assigned by Turael or Spria (Mazchna does not assign Dwarves). There is no Slayer level requirement.
slayerTargetId 287 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
The Dwarves task counts both dwarves and Black Guards; wikiPageId 16965 is the Dwarf monster page.
Dwarf: combat level 10, 16 HP, max hit 2 (stab), Defence 6 with a +5 magic defence bonus (npc 290/292/294/295/296/1401-1408/8496).
Black Guard (level 25): 30 HP, max hit 3, Defence 20 (npc 1409-1412); a level 48 Keldagrim form (npc 6046-6049) also counts.
None of the dwarves are undead, so the salve amulet does not apply. No task extension unlock exists for Dwarves.
recommendedMethod: Kill dwarves in the free-to-play Dwarven Mine beneath Ice Mountain (36 spawns) with any melee weapon; their Defence is trivial. Black Guards on Ice Mountain and in Keldagrim also count. Ranged is the better non-melee option, since dwarves carry a small +5 magic defence bonus.
